lastCompletedStory.title: appliedPatternIds reporting field on worker-report and handoff

nextStoryContext: US-005 added `appliedPatternIds?: string[]` as an optional field on `WorkerReport` (src/supervisor/worker-report.ts) and on `scripts/cam/handoff.schema.json`, parsed by `parseWorkerReport` (src/supervisor/report-parse.ts) via a new `isStringArray` guard: present-but-non-string-array rejects the WHOLE report (fail-closed, same convention as gates/notes), absent leaves the field undefined (backward compatible -- existing reports/handoffs without it still parse/validate). `formatWorkerReportSummary` was deliberately left untouched (no AC asked for it in the one-line pane summary). Agent instructions (.claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md + templates copy, .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md + templates copy -- all 4 edited, planner pair stayed byte-identical, implementer pair kept its pre-existing per-file divergence per the 'cam-dual-copy-is-per-file' convention) now tell the implementer to grep `scripts/cam/pattern-records.jsonl` (US-001 CAM-64's typed store) grep-on-demand exactly like `patterns.md`, and to report every applied record's id (its `fingerprintPatternRecord` -- 12-hex sha256 of `name::description::dir_anchors.join(',')`, since `PatternRecord` carries no stored id) in BOTH `worker-report.json` and `handoff.json`'s `appliedPatternIds`, computed via a one-line `bun -e` `Bun.CryptoHasher` snippet (no CLI helper exists for this). The planner's instructions mirror the same grep contract but do NOT write `appliedPatternIds` themselves (the planner has no worker-report/handoff of its own); instead it cites a record's fingerprint inline in a story's `notes` prose so the eventual implementer of that story can carry the id forward into its own report. Citing the not-yet-populated `scripts/cam/pattern-records.jsonl` path in the agent docs tripped `check:agents-md` (untracked + unignored, no seeding story per US-002) -- added a `KNOWN_MISSING` entry to `scripts/validate-agents-md.ts` in the same commit (a general lesson: any doc citation of a bootstrap-if-missing on-main store needs its KNOWN_MISSING entry the moment the citation lands, not later). `src/supervisor/worker-report.ts` grew 106->114 lines, raised in `scripts/file-size-budget.json` with a dated `_ref`. `bun run embed-vendor` was re-run (templates/ agent files changed) and `embed-vendor:check` is clean. NOT yet wired: nothing reads `appliedPatternIds` at runtime yet -- that consumption (loop.ts terminal-verdict hook calling `appendOutcomeOnMain` per id, mirroring the CAM-189 SUGGESTION hook) is US-006, already scoped in this PRD as 'requires: US-005'.
